name: mailcheck
description: MailCheck: email verification API and dashboard

scripts.dev: npm run migrate -w api && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev -w api" "npm:worker:dev -w api" "npm:dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
